title: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Dry Bulk Report - November 24, 2026

section_path_text: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Dry Bulk Report - November 24, 2026
summary:
Main
• Capesize Spot Rates Approaching $40,000 Once Again - As November draws to a close, Capesize spot rates remain historically elevated , hovering near the upper end of their recent range at roughly $40,000 per day despite subdued macroeconomic data and compressed steel margins that are gradually eroding iron ore demand. While December has historically brought some of the steepest seasonal rate corrections , a pattern currently reflected in the forward freight curve, the recent compression in volatility alongside highly profitable charter levels underscores the underlying tightness in the dry bulk market. Looking ahead to next year, although headline fleet growth is projected to outpace cargo demand growth , ongoing geopolitical disruptions across two active wars continue to absorb effective vessel capacity through extended ton-miles and rerouting, creating a structurally tighter market than baseline fundamentals suggest and supporting the case for another strong year.
